description: Defines the BufferItem class used in Android's graphics buffer management, including buffer properties, metadata, and serialization methods.

classes.name: BufferItem
classes.description: Represents a graphics buffer with associated metadata and state information, used in Android's graphics pipeline.

methods.name: getPodSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the Plain Old Data (POD) representation of BufferItem.

methods.name: getFlattenedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the flattened BufferItem for serialization.

methods.name: getFdCount
methods.description: Returns the number of file descriptors associated with the BufferItem.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Serializes the BufferItem into a buffer, file descriptors, and counts.

methods.name: unflatten
methods.description: Deserializes the BufferItem from a buffer and associated file descriptors.

methods.name: scalingModeName
methods.description: Returns the name of a scaling mode given its code.
